name: Krzysztof Lewandowski
bio:
Krzysztof's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karts. He quickly progressed through the ranks, displaying a natural talent for race strategy and car setup. However, he found his true calling on the management side. After earning a degree in engineering and an MBA, Krzysztof joined Premotion Racing, initially in a technical role, before transitioning to team management. His sharp analytical mind and ability to motivate his team led to his appointment as Team Principal of Proton by Premotion. Krzysztof is known for his data-driven approach, combined with an uncanny ability to predict opponent strategies. He believes a strong team culture is the foundation for success, fostering collaboration and open communication. 

Krzysztof emphasizes continuous improvement and is always looking for innovative ways to gain an edge. He is a firm believer in empowering his team members, giving them the autonomy to make decisions and take ownership of their work. While he is demanding, he is also supportive, creating an environment where people feel valued and respected. His dedication and passion are infectious, inspiring his team to achieve their full potential. He also has a habit of wearing a lucky pair of socks on race days, a tradition he started during his go-karting days.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Krzysztof is of average height with a lean build and an intense gaze.

Has a habit of pacing when making important decisions.
